snippet.title: 🎬 Sur Le Fil (SLF) — Teaser
snippet.description:
Sur Le Fil is an educational game where learning happens through experimentation, not lectures.

Build real electrical circuits, visualize currents, explore scientific concepts, and progress through a growing campus designed to make maths, physics, and logic intuitive.

No scores to grind.
No school pressure.
Just curiosity, understanding, and progression through action.

🔌 Interactive circuit simulator
🧠 Progressive learning system
🎓 Exams, missions, and experimentation
🌍 Multi-language support

Available for free on Steam and directly playable on the web (WebGL).
https://angelostudio.fr/

This teaser shows a glimpse of the SLF universe and its philosophy:
learning should feel like discovery, not obligation.
